intent: An editorial release timeline with version markers, feature and fix filters, and progressive disclosure for older entries, built for product changelogs.

layout.direction: A release timeline with an aligned version/date rail on wide containers and stacked entries on phones. Keep all three filters on one row at 320px and preserve a stable top edge during filtering.
layout.container: Full width, capped at 48rem with 24px narrow and 32px wide padding. The complete 1120px demo stage starts the timeline at its top padding.

typography.heading: 36px Instrument Serif title, 30px version figures and 18px medium release titles

motion.entrance: A single opacity and 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: New and filtered entries settle over 300ms with a 40ms bounded stagger. Controls retain native focus.
motion.reduced: Stop entry transforms immediately when reduced motion changes, retaining selected text and existing article nodes.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.
Use reader-scoped high-contrast text selection in both themes; preserve selected content when reduced motion changes.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: releases
props.description: Ordered versions, ISO date labels, summaries and typed feature/fix entries.

props.name: initialCount
props.description: Initial number of matching releases; remaining entries can be disclosed.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Pass releases in the intended display order with stable IDs, ISO date strings and feature/fix changes. The component preserves the supplied order.
Everything, Features and Fixes are native pressed buttons. Filtering changes the visible entries and their change lists; empty matches have written feedback.
initialCount is a finite initial limit, rounded down and clamped to one; non-finite limits fall back to two. The local older-releases disclosure applies within the current filter.
Keep publishing and routing in the host. This reader does not save a release or invent a remote action. Reduced motion settles article movement without replacing the filter controls.
